evals.name: on-demand-ts-repo
evals.prompt: Can you audit the code quality on this repo? It's a TypeScript service, a few hundred files. I want to know where the worst complexity hotspots are, whether we have any dependency cycles, and honestly whether our tests are actually testing anything or just executing code. Give me a prioritized list of what to fix first.
evals.expected_output: A report following the SKILL.md format: summary table across all five axes, findings grouped by fail/warn/skipped, and a recommendations section prioritized by impact.

assertions.name: stack-detected-as-typescript
assertions.description: Report identifies the stack as TypeScript.

assertions.name: on-demand-mode-no-verdict
assertions.description: No PASS/FAIL verdict (on-demand mode).

assertions.name: recommendations-section-present
assertions.description: Recommendations section is present.

assertions.name: complexity-hotspot-detected
assertions.description: processOrder in orders.ts flagged for complexity.

assertions.name: dependency-cycle-detected
assertions.description: audit.ts ↔ logger.ts cycle flagged as fail.

assertions.name: five-axis-summary-table
assertions.description: Summary table lists all five axes.

assertions.name: weak-tests-or-mutation-finding
assertions.description: Addresses user's 'tests actually testing' concern via mutation or coverage commentary.

evals.name: phase-gate-pass-fail-verdict
evals.prompt: I'm about to mark phase 3 of my implementation plan complete. Before I do, run the quality gate so I know whether this is actually shippable or whether I'm fooling myself. Give me a clear PASS or FAIL at the end.
evals.expected_output: Gate-mode report: explicit PASS/FAIL verdict at top, no recommendations section.

assertions.name: gate-mode-verdict-present
assertions.description: Explicit Verdict: PASS or FAIL line.

assertions.name: gate-mode-no-recommendations
assertions.description: No Recommendations section (gate mode).

assertions.name: stack-detected-as-python
assertions.description: Stack identified as Python.

assertions.name: five-axis-summary-table
assertions.description: Summary table lists all five axes.

assertions.name: findings-section-structured
assertions.description: Findings grouped into Fails / Warnings / Skipped.

assertions.name: verdict-matches-findings
assertions.description: Verdict is logically consistent with Fails section contents.

evals.name: partial-audit-missing-tool
evals.prompt: Run a code quality audit on my Python package. Fair warning — I don't think we have mutation testing set up yet, but I want coverage, complexity, and the dependency structure checked anyway.
evals.expected_output: On-demand report. Mutation axis reported as skipped with install hint. Other axes actually run.

assertions.name: stack-detected-as-python
assertions.description: Stack identified as Python.

assertions.name: mutation-reported-as-skipped
assertions.description: Mutation axis is ⊘ skipped, not failed.

assertions.name: mutmut-install-hint-present
assertions.description: Install command (pip install mutmut) present in Skipped section.

assertions.name: coverage-axis-attempted
assertions.description: Coverage axis is actually run, not skipped.

assertions.name: complexity-axis-attempted
assertions.description: Complexity axis is actually run, not skipped.

assertions.name: dependency-cycle-detected
assertions.description: audit.py ↔ logger.py cycle flagged.

assertions.name: on-demand-mode-no-verdict
assertions.description: No PASS/FAIL verdict.

assertions.name: recommendations-section-present
assertions.description: Recommendations section present.
